name: msx-milestone-assistant
description: Synthetic MSX-style mock application for Solution Engineering opportunity and milestone management. Not connected to real MSX, Dataverse, or any production Microsoft system.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @msx/shared && npm run build -w @msx/api && npm run build -w @msx/web
scripts.db:reset: prisma db push --force-reset && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
